object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Open the Figure menu with and without a figure attached; choose View full size with a figure, and for an object without one. Expected: View full size is enabled with a figure and disabled without; a viewer opens on the object's figure file figures/<object ID>.svg, titled Figure — <object ID>, showing a valid picture; for the object without a figure no viewer opens.
